facts.activity_file: loading, restraining and placarding a load

assets.label: workshop hoists and press
assets.service: heavy vehicle component removal and pressing

control_failures.control_label: segregation of light vehicles and pedestrians from heavy equipment

facts.site: Yandarra Downs Open Cut and Heavy Workshop
facts.title: hazard report - kinetic exposure at HO-9401

response.consequence: The recorded outcome was no injury or loss. The potential outcome was rated 2 against the site's consequence scale, above the 0 actually realised.

defences.finding: Control PROXIMITY_DETECTION_AND_SEGREGATION: the segregation of light vehicles and pedestrians from heavy equipment was not in place, and the root cause analysis classified this as an organisational factor.

recommendations: Confirm at the next field verification that the segregation of light vehicles and pedestrians from heavy equipment on HO-9401 and M-9401 performs as designed.
response.sequence: Work was under way in transporting materials by road, specifically loading, restraining and placarding a load. HO-9401 (workshop hoists and press) is in service for heavy vehicle component removal and pressing. The task proceeded during start-up after maintenance while the segregation of light vehicles and pedestrians from heavy equipment was not in place. The kinetic energy involved is held as rotating equipment, and the recorded presentation was entanglement, impact, crush.
response.summary: On 2 June 2013 a hazard report was recorded on HO-9401 and M-9401 at Yandarra Downs Open Cut and Heavy Workshop during start-up after maintenance; kinetic energy held as rotating equipment was not released.
